pages.text: The curse takes its toll. Every $(l)ten minutes$() of play you develop an $(l)affliction$(): blindness, brittle bones, a missing hand, tics, an allergy to flowers... twenty-four in all. You can carry three.

$(l)Stand beside a lit bonfire for five seconds$() and they all ease. Then the clock starts again. Each death brings the next one two minutes sooner.$(br2)$(l)/trigger fl_afflictions$() lists yours, and how long until the next. Everyone else is told when you develop one.
Unless you have $(l)Anosognosia$(). Then you're fine. Completely fine. Don't listen to them.
